ui.card.title: Power-outage card
ui.card.emptyMessage: If someone at home relies on powered medical equipment or refrigerated medication, add it to get a one-page card for power outages.
ui.medical.title: Medical device details
ui.medical.label: Name on the card
ui.medical.refrigeration: Needs to stay cold (medication), not power directly
ui.medical.noDiagnosis: No diagnosis is needed. Only what the equipment is.
ui.medical.tested: Set up and tested with it
ui.medical.backupFooter: Turn on "Works with" only if the supplier or manufacturer confirmed it.
ui.medical.runtimeHours: Hours, from the manufacturer or care plan
ui.medical.runtimeFooter: Leave empty if you don't know. Dry Run never estimates how long a device or a person can go without power.
ui.contact.name: Name
ui.contact.footer: The equipment supplier, care team, or the utility's medical registry is who the card tells people to call.
ui.place.name: Place
ui.place.footer: A place appears on the card only after the host confirms you can come and it has power.
ui.share.readyFooter: You can share now. Filling these in first makes the copy more useful.
